plugins.description: Joomla 5+ / 6 / 7 skill suite — one reference skill for building extensions (components, modules, plugins, libraries, templates with modern MVC, PSR-4 namespaces, DI, and service providers), twelve non-overlapping security audit workflows (authorisation, controller exposure, object-level access, SQL filtering, XSS, sensitive output, file operations, code execution, SSRF/redirects, secrets/crypto, package surface, _JEXEC guards), plus four maintenance workflows (Joomla deprecations, stable-PHP compatibility, upcoming-PHP compatibility, and Docker-over-HTTP end-to-end tests).
